alerts.title: Viral load monitoring interval appears overdue
alerts.message: The DTG-based regimen guideline recommends viral load checks every 6 months, with reduction to 12-monthly only if VL is below 50 copies/mL for over 1 year with reliable adherence. The last recorded viral load was 2025-09-15, 129 days before this visit, which is within the 6-month window, but the record shows only two viral loads (2024-09-15 and 2025-09-15), both undetectable at 30 and 20 copies/mL. The clinician plan does not document a viral load order or the interval being used. Confirm whether the patient has been placed on 12-monthly testing and document the rationale, or schedule the next viral load within 6 months of the last result.

evidence.recommended_action: Document the viral load monitoring interval. If stable undetectable VL with reliable adherence for over 1 year, 12-monthly testing is permissible; otherwise schedule VL within 6 months of 2025-09-15.
